t: You're in Burgess Park, in Camberwell. At 56 hectares it's the largest park in the borough of Southwark, with Walworth to the north, Bermondsey to the east and Peckham to the south. It's named after Jessie Burgess, a Labour councillor on Camberwell Metropolitan Borough Council from 1934 to 1951. She was the first woman to be Mayor of Camberwell, was made an Honorary Freeman of Camberwell in 1958, and received a CBE in 1966.
